description:
A new morning memo has been saved to your Documents folder ('~/Documents/morning_memo.txt'). It contains instructions from the portfolio manager regarding a new set of banking stocks to monitor. 

Your task is to:
1. Open and read the memo to understand the requirements.
2. Create a NEW watchlist in JStock named 'Big Banks'.
3. Populate this watchlist with ONLY the stocks requested in the memo, adhering strictly to any exclusion instructions mentioned.

Ensure the final watchlist is saved and contains the correct tickers.
